summary: Learn Kafka operations, diagnostics, replication and consumer recovery through practical exercises. Explore the course outline and plan your training.
lede: Apache Kafka data streaming training covers operating and troubleshooting event pipelines for data engineers, platform operators and support analysts. Participants learn to use command-line tools to inspect topics and offsets, interpret consumer-group lag, assess replication health, configure producer and consumer settings, and check Kafka Connect task status. They also create incident and capacity records and an operations runbook, while Kafka Streams and advanced application development receive conceptual introductions only.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who configure, monitor or support Kafka event pipelines and need a grounded foundation in cluster and client operations.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with data pipelines and command-line concepts is helpful. No prior Apache Kafka experience or programming is required; course exercises focus on Kafka CLI inspection, configuration choices and operational documentation rather than writing application code.
